title: Musicviddle
tagline: Music video guessing game sensation !! Test your music video knowledge against the world !!
description: In the spirits of "Wordle", Musicviddle is a video guessing game that challenges the user with 5 screengrabs of a popular music video delivered one at a time starting with the most obscure and ending with the most obvious. Users can guess the video at each screengrab. The quicker you answer the better the score !! Compare your music video trivia knowledge against world.
how_its_made: This project uses many web3 components such as Polygon, IPFS/Filecoin and Fluence. Unfortunately I would love to have used Fluence but ran into compiler issues. Incentives are implemented through NFT/Smart contracts. The user experience is completely verified through smart contracts and blockchain transactions
